R01.quote: `enum :status, { draft: 0, ready: 1 }, prefix: true` (before bump: yes)
R01.reasons: Validation only says the status filters pass. It does not persist unequal draft and ready notes or exercise the prefixed helpers after reload.

R02.quote: `serialize :tags, coder: JSON` (7.1+ only, so ship it with the bump)
R02.reasons: Validation is only a general claim that JSON tags read unchanged. It does not test unequal tags, comma-separated editing or the stored representation.

R03.reasons: The radio-button check after save does not cover reloading JSON settings, error rendering or preserving existing settings.

R04.reasons: There is no specific validation, only the overall suite result. Unequal notebook populations, a second owner and foreign-notebook denial are not checked.

R05.quote: The receipt changes from `On idleness,10.1000/Essays.1` to `On idleness,`.
R05.reasons: The exact-receipt test does not explicitly use distinct DOIs and compare them with the persisted citations.

R06.quote: With one valid row and one invalid row, the import and the valid note are saved: `record_counts` changed from `[0, 3, 0, 1]` to `[1, 4, 1, 2]`.

R07.quote: `TypeError: String can't be coerced into Integer`. Every export job fails.
R07.reasons: Validation says only that the export tests download the file. It does not check the exact ordered Markdown bytes from the real worker or the failed-export control.

R08.quote: `stringify_keys` turns the Integer line keys into `"2"`, so `annotations[2]` is nil.
R08.reasons: It checks lines 2 and 3, not unequal annotations at lines 2 and 4 with a multiline CSV row, and it does not confirm that nothing is saved.

R10.reasons: The test checks only one offset string. It does not compare epochs across the DST boundary or include a non-boundary control.

R11.quote: In the mailer, add `requested_at = requested_at.in_time_zone("UTC")` after reading params.
R11.reasons: It runs a single digest test and a payload control. It does not use a real queue and worker crossing each midnight, and it does not inspect reservation keys or note membership.

R12.quote: A 7.0 worker given that payload raises `ActiveJob::DeserializationError` ... deploy `DigestJob.perform_later(self, requested_at, reading_completion.to_s)` on 7.0 first.
R12.reasons: It has cross-version deserialization probes and a proposed staging drain check, but no full producer/consumer matrix with same-version controls and an exact delivered completion percentage.

R13.quote: With `Time.at`, both versions scheduled the job at `2026-10-31 13:00:00 UTC` in `Sidekiq::ScheduledSet`.
R13.reasons: It does not check the persisted schedule time or include the replacement and ownership controls.

R14.quote: This is raised at enqueue time, inside `Citation#request_enrichment`'s lock, so the request returns 500.
R14.reasons: The plan claims a 500 at enqueue time, which is not the key's consequence: bounded ActiveJob retry breaks and the job falls into Sidekiq retries. Validation is one passing test, without the persistent-503, 503->200 and 401 scenarios.

R15.quote: `Passed nil to the :model argument, expect an object or false`. Every note list and the post-sign-in page return 500.
R15.reasons: There is no specific validation beyond the overall suite. The plan does not check form names, method, submission or the resulting note membership.

R16.quote: The route list on 8.1 contains both `GET /notes` and `GET /journal`, and the test "lists the reader's notes newest first at both list paths" passes.

R17.quote: This is 7.1+ only, so ship it with the bump: on 7.0 the symbol counts as true and the error pages would be rendered.
R17.reasons: It names the failing exception assertions but does not cover the normal test and CI eager-loading modes.

R18.reasons: The probe checks details/summary and script stripping only. It does not test attachment markup, event handlers or javascript URLs.

R19.quote: fresh `bin/rails runner` boot with `CITATION_PROVIDER_USER=00123` and password `"sample: value # keep"`, which arrive unchanged
R19.reasons: It does not verify the actual Basic header, successful metadata or bounded failure behavior.

R09.reasons: The only test is the past-deadline case. It does not cover the before-deadline case, cached versus fresh reads, or authoritative download expiry and ownership.

R20.quote: `serialize :preferences, coder: YAML` (7.1+, ship with the bump). The stored YAML stays readable.
R20.reasons: It relies only on the suite results. There is no create/edit/reload of unequal preferences or export-heading check with the gate both off and on.

R21.quote: Repair: `permit(:name, :export_heading)`. ... notebooks_controller_test.rb:22 (slug stays "novels" while the name changes); the create test is the control.
R21.reasons: It does not test an export-heading change or explicitly test an attempted slug change.

R23.quote: `Date.iso8601(day)` raises `TypeError: no implicit conversion of Date into String`. Repair: `[day.to_date, count]`.
R23.reasons: It relies only on the suite run under the 8.1 defaults. There is no decoding off/on comparison, asymmetric UTC counts, empty report or ownership check.

R25.quote: a matching `If-None-Match` returns 304 even if `If-Modified-Since` is older. This is harmless because the blob checksum is the ETag.
R25.reasons: The plan calls the change harmless rather than making an explicit keep/adopt decision. It also proposes no validation: the case was not probed and no ETag-list or validator scenarios are listed.
